judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Indicator-grain statements at the same Class X coordinate (rank 1) within Chapter 12 – Electricity / 'How things work', so the comparison is within-grain and same-rank. C188 (second) requires explaining how an electric circuit functions in text and through a diagram, sitting under CLO81 'Explains the process of electric conduction, electric circuit, Ohm's law' — qualitative/structural understanding of circuit operation and representation. C190 (first) requires calculating resistance, potential difference, current and heating of a circuit, under CLO83 'Calculates the unknown variable by using appropriate formula and assigning a relevant unit' and LO8 (calculation with given data). The substantive change is from qualitative explanation and diagrammatic representation of circuit behaviour to quantitative application of the same circuit relationships (Ohm's law, series/parallel, heating effect); proficiency in reading and explaining circuit function supports success in selecting and applying the correct circuit formulas, so the developmental direction runs from C188 to C190 rather than the reverse. Shared 'circuit'/'electricity' LC tags, page 78 proximity and shared organizers were treated only as nomination signals; the judgment rests on the statement and LC content. Source evidence for both SFIs is truncated and both carry upstream merge/audit context, which limits certainty but does not conflict with this reading.

judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are same-grain Content Domain Specific Learning Outcomes (CLO35, CLO31) at the same resolved coordinate Class IX under Chapter 6 – Tissues in the World of the Living domain, so the judgment rests on statement content rather than shared ancestry alone. CLO35 asks learners to explain the broad categories of plant tissues (meristematic, permanent) and animal tissues (epithelial, connective, muscular, nervous); CLO31 asks learners to differentiate specific sub-types (parenchyma, sclerenchyma, collenchyma; striated muscle, nerve fibres) using diagrams, properties, functions and slide observation. Command of the overarching tissue classification and the function of each broad type plausibly supports success in the finer, observation-based discrimination of named sub-tissues, which is a substantive increase in specificity and in the evidence base used (diagrams/slides) rather than mere repetition. Direction is same-rank but justified by this category-to-sub-type and explain-to-differentiate deepening; the differing NCERT LO parents (LO5 explain-processes vs LO1 differentiate-based-on-properties) in the DAG are consistent with this reading. Source evidence for both endpoints is truncated (32 omitted items each) and both carry upstream merge/audit context, so this remains a bounded inference.

judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Class X (rank 1) Content Domain Specific Learning Outcomes in the same grain, sharing Chapter 'Electricity' and Content Domain 'How things work'. CLO85 asks learners to use SI units and symbols for current, charge, potential difference, resistance and resistivity; CLO88 asks them to derive equations for resistivity, for series/parallel resistor combinations, and for Joule's law of heating. Command of the symbolic and unit conventions for exactly those electrical quantities is a substantive enabling competence for algebraically deriving relations among them, so proficiency in CLO85 supports likelihood of success in CLO88 (same-rank, forward within Class X). The reverse is not supported: derivation of relations is the more complex, combinatory task. Shared chapter/page proximity and token overlap alone were not treated as sufficient; the judgment rests on the pair-specific content relation between symbol/unit fluency and equation derivation. Note that both endpoints' source evidence is truncated and both carry upstream merge/audit context, so this is an inference from the bounded excerpt.

judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are same-grain Content Domain Specific Learning Outcomes (CLO22, CLO24) in Class X (rank 1), Chapter 6 – Life Processes, The World of the Living, so the comparison is within the configured grain. CLO22 requires drawing labelled diagrams/flowcharts that map the pathways and organs of digestion, respiration, circulation and excretion (representational, structural mastery of the systems, parented by NCERT LO6 on drawing diagrams/flow charts). CLO24 requires applying that learning of life processes to hypothetical situations and predicting consequences/implications (parented by NCERT LO11 on hypothetical application). The substantive change is cognitive extension from explicit representation of the pathway/organ structure to reasoning about perturbations of those same pathways; secure command of what the pathways and organs are makes success in predicting consequences of hypothetical disruptions in life processes more likely, so the same-rank developmental direction runs from CLO22 (second) to CLO24 (first) rather than the reverse. Shared chapter/domain and token overlap ('life processes') alone were not treated as sufficient; the judgment rests on the stated outcome texts and their differing NCERT LO parents. judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Class IX Content Domain Specific Learning Outcomes (CLO37, CLO43) in the same 'The World of the Living' domain but under different chapters (Chapter 6 – Tissues vs Chapter 7 – Diversity in living organisms) and different NCERT LO parents (LO11 hypothetical application vs LO4 relating processes/phenomena to causes/effects). Same statement-type grain and identical Class IX rank 0, so no lower-to-higher developmental direction is available from coordinates, and neither text shows substantive same-rank deepening: CLO37 asks for hypothetical reasoning about consequences of missing tissue types/structures (e.g. clogged stomata), while CLO43 asks for relating evolutionary linkages across phyla/divisions/classes via body design and characteristics. There is nevertheless genuine conceptual coherence: both reason about structural organization and its consequences in plants and animals, and tissue-level structure/function is part of the body-design criteria used in comparing groups of organisms, so they reinforce each other without asserting dependency. Token/trigram and adjacent-page overlap is largely generic ('plants', 'animals', 'etc') and was not treated as decisive. judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Class X Indicators (same statement-type grain, same resolved coordinate rank 1) in Chapter 7 'Control and Coordination' under 'The World of the Living'. C94 ('Relates bending in plants to differential growth') gives the causal/mechanistic account of tropic bending, while C88 ('Investigates the type of stimulus and resulting movements across variety of plants') is the empirical investigation of stimulus types and resulting plant movements; their LCs share the tags 'plants' and 'tropism'. This is genuine conceptual and skill coherence within plant tropism — investigation of stimulus-response movements and explanation by differential growth mutually reinforce each other. judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Class X (rank 1) Indicators in the same Chapter 3 'Metals and Non-metals' / 'Materials' scope, so the grain matches and direction must rest on substantive content, not shared ancestry. C20 asks learners to relate the reactivity of metals to their position in the Periodic Table and their properties (LCs: 'relates reactivity of metals to their properties', '...to their position in the Periodic Table'). C31 applies exactly that reactivity ordering in a more complex, procedural context: extraction of metals, enrichment of ores, 'extracting metals according to their position in activity series' and refining, with examples and equations (LC: 'explains extracting metals according to their position in the activity series with suitable examples and equations'). Command of the reactivity/position relationship plausibly supports success in explaining activity-series-based extraction and refining, so a same-rank forward direction from C20 to C31 is supported by pair-specific content, not merely shared chapter, wording ('metals', 'position', 'reactivity') or adjacent source pages. The endpoints sit under different parent CLOs (CLO7 classification/bonding vs CLO9 properties/reactivity/extraction) in the DAG, which is consistent with application rather than mere repetition. Merge/audit context on both endpoints and their ancestors is duplicate-extraction and organizer consolidation only, and the truncated source evidence (32 and 24 omitted items) limits but does not contradict this reading.

judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Class IX Content Domain Specific Learning Outcomes (CLO62, CLO68) in the same grain, sharing Chapter 'Force & Laws of Motion' and Content Domain 'Moving things, People and Ideas'. CLO62 relates Newton's three laws of motion and conservation of momentum to causes/effects (under NCERT LO4, cause-effect reasoning), while CLO68 describes the historical contributions of Galileo and Newton in this field (under NCERT LO15, scientific discoveries/inventions). The content is substantively coherent — understanding the laws of motion and the historical development attributed to Galileo and Newton mutually reinforce one another — but they serve different cognitive aims (causal explanation vs. historical description) and sit at the same resolved coordinate rank (Class IX, rank 0) with no evidence that proficiency in one supports success in the other, so no developmental direction is supported. Endpoint source evidence is truncated (24 omitted evidence items per endpoint) and several ancestors carry merge/audit context, which limits but does not contradict this symmetric judgment.

judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Indicators at the same grain and same resolved coordinate (Class X, rank 1) within Chapter 9 'Heredity and Evolution' of the Content Domain 'The World of the Living', but they sit under different Content Domain Specific Learning Outcomes: C153 under CLO60 (drawing labelled genetic diagrams/flow charts/Punnett squares to illustrate inheritance of traits over generations and sex determination, LCs tagged diagrams/genetics/punnett square/inheritance) and C155 under CLO62 (applying heredity and inheritance to predict trait expression; LC 'predicts the proportion of features in offspring from furnished genetic data on parents'). Beyond shared chapter and the single shared 'inheritance' LC tag, there is pair-specific substantive support for same-rank direction: constructing and labelling Punnett squares/genetic diagrams is the representational tool by which offspring trait ratios are derived, so proficiency in C153's representation skill supports success in C155's quantitative prediction of proportions from parental genetic data. Direction is therefore second_to_first (C153 -> C155). judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Indicator-grain statements resolved to Class IX (rank 0) under Chapter 13 'Why do we fall ill?' in the World of the Living Content Domain, so the comparison stays within grain and within one class. C227 requires applying knowledge of infectious agents, transmission, symptoms and treatment to design preventive strategies for containment of disease in the neighbourhood/community (parent CLO97). C230 requires propagating awareness of local communicable diseases and their prevention through visual aids, newspaper cuttings, posters and role play (parent CLO100 'Propagates awareness around communicable diseases and prevention strategies', with LO18 on communicating findings on one ancestor path). The two share substantive subject matter - local communicable diseases, their transmission and their prevention - and are complementary performances: one analyses and designs prevention/containment measures, the other communicates disease and prevention information to the community. That is meaningful pair-specific instructional coherence rather than generic repetition or mere shared organizers. A developmental claim is not supported: at equal rank, C230 is not a deepening, extension, or increased-complexity version of C227; it changes the performance mode to outreach/communication and its underlying disease-prevention knowledge demand is no greater (plausibly lighter) than the design demand in C227, so neither direction can be asserted on this evidence. C24 asks the learner to conduct that activity (parented under CLO8, reached via LO3 'Plans and conducts investigations/experiments'), while C35 asks the learner to draw the diagram showing the same action (parented under CLO10 'Draws labelled diagrams for the metallurgical processes', reached via LO6 diagram drawing). This is substantive pair-specific coherence: two complementary skills - hands-on performance and diagrammatic representation - addressing one identical activity, which is instructionally mutually reinforcing rather than merely repetitive or merely co-located in the same chapter. Canonical symmetric relatesTo with null direction is therefore the complete judgment.
